title: Pressure in liquids: three jets from a water tank (তরলের ভেতর চাপ)
placement: Book page 134, topic 5.3 (তরলের ভেতর চাপ, Pressure in Liquids): next to চিত্র 5.02 (a beaker with an imagined column of liquid of height h above a surface A: 'তরলের উচ্চতার জন্য নিচের পৃষ্ঠে চাপ সৃষ্টি হয়'), the derivation F = mg = (Ahρ)g, P = F/A = hρg, and the sentences on pressure growing with depth and 1 atm = 101325 Pa (the section runs onto page 135 with চিত্র 5.03).
description: Pressure in liquids (page 134, topic 5.3) in a courtyard at sunset: a tall clear glass tank of rich blue water, 1 m deep, stands on a brick stand in front of a saffron lime-plastered wall with a band of cobalt and white tiles and a marigold garland, over terracotta floor tiles. Three brass spouts on its side, 0.2, 0.4 and 0.6 m below the surface, are stopped with corks. Inside the water the book's figure 5.02 is drawn: an imagined dashed column of water above a teal surface A (100 cm²) at the depth h, a purple arrow for its weight F = (Ahρ)g pressing on A, and a blue dimension for h. The student opens the holes one at a time (the big numbered button, or a tap on a spout): the cork pops, a jet of water arcs out to a stone channel on the floor (the deeper the hole, the harder and further: Torricelli's parabola, drawn to scale) and a bold red arrow at the hole shows the pressure there, its length in proportion to P; the first time, the camera goes close to the hole and back. The surface A can be dragged up and down (or moved with the arrow keys) and the panel works out the book's P = hρg live, with ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³ and g = 9.8 m s⁻² and Bangla digits. The rule grows in the book's words: the weight of the column above A, pressure growing with depth in a liquid of a given density (the depth gauge beside the tank fills red, deeper is redder), about one atmosphere (1 atm = 101325 Pa) for every ten metres of water. Test tab: 5 questions (the pressure at a marked hole with its depth read off the gauge; why the bottom jet goes furthest; A lowered to twice the depth; where the pressure on A comes from with the holes closed; the pressure 10 m down), every wrong choice a real mistake with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
